For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.
sql:
WITH daily_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        SUM(daily_change) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as running_balance
    FROM daily_balance
),
first_txn AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as first_date
    FROM running_balance
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
with_offset AS (
    SELECT 
        rb.customer_id,
        rb.txn_date,
        rb.running_balance,
        CAST(rb.txn_date AS DATE) - f.first_date as day_interval,
        CAST(rb.txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date
    FROM running_balance rb
    JOIN first_txn f ON rb.customer_id = f.customer_id
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        running_balance,
        CASE WHEN AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) < 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE AVG(running_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) END as thirty_day_avg
    FROM with_offset
    WHERE day_interval >= 29
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
        CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_month_start,
        MAX(thirty_day_avg) as max_30day_avg
    FROM rolling_avg
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
first_month AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(CAST(rb.txn_date AS DATE)) as first_month_start
    FROM running_balance rb
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
